act_descr: - Chapter 1 [+]: Stranded by a 2 a.m. fire alarm at Meyer Green, Ines and Ishita split a Coupa coupon, compare calendars, and walk residents back to EVGR together.
chapters: Mateo scrapes RA data for his bot, Zadie confronts him, Ines refuses to help, and Ishita stays late fixing mislabeled imaging files to keep her spot.
Carlos teaches Ines knife skills and clocks her out on time, while Yifan walks Ishita through a clean CPT plan and drafts her supervisor letter.
A financial‑aid “verification” flags Ines’s remittances and eats her week, Farzaneh’s 1 a.m. Slack lights up, and Ishita gets a nosebleed waiting in the CAPS N95 line.
Ines ships a tidy helpdesk script that stops a dorm Wi‑Fi loop, Ishita lands her first clean imaging run, and they celebrate with extra meal swipes at Arrillaga.
Wildfire smoke cancels classes as Mateo launches the dorm bot anyway, Naomi starts asking lab–startup money questions, and Farzaneh warns the team to keep edits off email.
act_scenes:
Chapter 1:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Ines, Ishita, EVGR residents
- Place: Meyer Green → EVGR courtyard and elevators
- Time: 2:00–3:30 a.m., first week of quarter
- Event: Fire alarm strands everyone; Ines and Ishita split a Coupa coupon, compare calendars, and walk residents back to EVGR.
- Conflict: Exhaustion vs RA duty; boundaries vs stepping up for residents
- Story value: Trust/Connection
- Story value charge: Positive
- Mood: Bleary, practical, warming
- Outcome: They coordinate routes, swap availability, and establish an easy rapport.

Scene 2:
- Characters: Mateo, Zadie, Ines, Ishita
- Place: EVGR dorm room (Mateo/RA data scrape); Clark Center imaging core (Ishita)
- Time: Next evening, 8:00 p.m.–1:00 a.m.
- Event: Mateo scrapes RA data for his bot; Zadie confronts him; Ines refuses to help; Ishita stays late fixing mislabeled files to protect her slot.
- Conflict: Shortcuts vs ethics; time pressure vs accuracy
- Story value: Integrity/Reputation
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Tense, transactional
- Outcome: Mateo doubles down; Zadie issues a warning; Ines distances; Ishita keeps her spot but loses sleep.

Chapter 2:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Ines, Carlos, line cooks
- Place: Arrillaga Dining kitchen
- Time: Friday shift, 3:00–6:00 p.m.
- Event: Carlos teaches Ines knife skills and quietly clocks her out on time.
- Conflict: Speed vs safety; wage creep vs protection
- Story value: Competence/Dignity
- Story value charge: Positive
- Mood: Focused, steadying
- Outcome: Ines improves technique, gets protected hours, and earns a mentor.

Scene 2:
- Characters: Ishita, Yifan
- Place: Lab office and Zoom with HR
- Time: Early evening, same day
- Event: Yifan walks Ishita through a clean CPT plan and drafts the supervisor letter.
- Conflict: Bureaucracy vs clarity
- Story value: Legitimacy/Visa security
- Story value charge: Positive
- Mood: Methodical, relieving
- Outcome: CPT checklist locked; Ishita knows her milestones and dates.

Chapter 3:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Ines, Financial Aid rep (remote), Mom (texts)
- Place: Financial Aid portal, Tresidder lobby
- Time: Monday–Wednesday, scattered hours
- Event: “Verification” flags Ines’s remittances; document requests pile up and consume her week.
- Conflict: Family obligation vs institutional rules; time sink vs classes
- Story value: Stability/Time
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Draining, bureaucratic
- Outcome: Case moved to “Pending Review”; midterms prep slips.

Scene 2:
- Characters: Ishita, Farzaneh, CAPS staff, students in line
- Place: CAPS clinic entrance; lab Slack (1 a.m.)
- Time: Thursday 12:30–2:00 a.m.
- Event: Farzaneh’s late Slack pings multiply; Ishita gets a nosebleed waiting in the CAPS N95 line.
- Conflict: Health vs workload; access vs triage
- Story value: Health/Support
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Wired, faintly alarming
- Outcome: She gets an N95 after a long wait; returns to backlog and unanswered pings.

Chapter 4:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Ines, Helpdesk lead, two students with tickets
- Place: IT helpdesk bullpen
- Time: Late afternoon
- Event: Ines ships a tidy script that stops a dorm Wi‑Fi loop.
- Conflict: Junior status vs taking initiative
- Story value: Competence/Recognition
- Story value charge: Positive
- Mood: Crisp, quietly proud
- Outcome: Loop resolved; lead merges her fix with a brief “nice catch.”

Scene 2:
- Characters: Ishita, Yifan, Ines
- Place: Imaging core → Arrillaga Dining
- Time: Evening into night
- Event: Ishita lands her first clean imaging run; they celebrate with extra meal swipes.
- Conflict: Performance anxiety vs execution
- Story value: Confidence/Belonging
- Story value charge: Positive
- Mood: Light, earned
- Outcome: Usable dataset captured; small win shared.

Chapter 5:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Mateo, EVGR residents, Ines, Zadie
- Place: EVGR lounges and group chats
- Time: Morning–noon under wildfire smoke; classes canceled
- Event: Mateo launches the dorm bot anyway.
- Conflict: Safety messaging vs opportunistic rollout; privacy concerns
- Story value: Trust/Safety
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Hazy, edgy
- Outcome: Bot gains users fast but triggers complaints and RA unease.

Scene 2:
- Characters: Naomi, Farzaneh, Ishita, Yifan, lab
- Place: Lab conference room and Slack
- Time: Afternoon, same day
- Event: Naomi starts probing lab–startup money flows; Farzaneh warns to keep edits off email.
- Conflict: Transparency vs secrecy; career risk vs compliance
- Story value: Integrity/Exposure
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Cautious, coded
- Outcome: Questions tabled; discussions move to hallway and Signal.

act_scenes:
Chapter 6:
Scene 1:
Characters: Ishita, night security, grad labmates
Place: Bioengineering lab, basement and stairwell
Time: 2:10 a.m., during the atmospheric river
Event: Alarms blare; Ishita ignores evac to haul organoid plates upstairs to a generator-backed incubator.
Conflict: Safety protocol vs. saving a months-long experiment.
Story value: Scientific integrity vs. personal risk
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Urgent, wet, fluorescent
Outcome: Plates are stabilized; security logs her badge violation.

Scene 2:
Characters: Ines, imaging core tech, courier
Place: Imaging core loading dock and microscope room
Time: 3:00 a.m., same storm
Event: Ines bikes in with dry ice to keep sample queue alive; patches a condensate leak on the cryo line.
Conflict: Equipment limits vs. time-sensitive imaging window.
Story value: Reliability in crisis
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Gritty, focused
Outcome: Imaging queue preserved; tech quietly flags Ines as the reason the run survived.

Chapter 7:
Scene 1:
Characters: Ishita, Farzaneh
Place: PI office
Time: Late morning, next day
Event: Farzaneh hands Ishita a “preprocessing” script to brighten panels for a Nature figure.
Conflict: Cosmetic enhancement vs. data fidelity.
Story value: Ethics
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Smiling pressure, tight
Outcome: Ishita takes the script, uneasy.

Scene 2:
Characters: Omar, lab group, Farzaneh, Ishita
Place: Lab meeting room
Time: Afternoon
Event: Omar flags missing controls; Farzaneh deflects and moves on.
Conflict: Whistle vs. hierarchy
Story value: Transparency
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Chilled, performative
Outcome: Omar is removed from the private Slack thread; Ishita stays silent.

Chapter 8:
Scene 1:
Characters: Ines, Naomi
Place: Engineering library study room
Time: Evening
Event: Ines ships an ethics-audit script; Naomi runs it against doc repos and finds grant-to-cap-table links.
Conflict: Access constraints vs. evidentiary rigor.
Story value: Accountability
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Tense, methodical
Outcome: They see Farzaneh’s stealth-equity filing mapped to lab outputs.

Scene 2:
Characters: Ines, Naomi
Place: Same room, screens aglow
Time: Minutes later
Event: They capture screenshots and timestamps before permissions can be revoked.
Conflict: Retaliation risk vs. preservation of proof.
Story value: Security of truth
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Hushed, decisive
Outcome: Evidence package duplicated to off-site storage.

Chapter 9:
Scene 1:
Characters: Ishita, Arjun
Place: Outside EVGR, under a dripping awning
Time: Night
Event: Arjun pitches a “CPT‑compatible” role at his startup, off HR books.
Conflict: Opportunity vs. legality/visa risk.
Story value: Career trajectory
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Tempting, gray
Outcome: Ishita asks for details, doesn’t reject it.

Scene 2:
Characters: Ishita, Yifan
Place: Café corner table
Time: Next afternoon
Event: Yifan shows a clause that could jeopardize future consular renewals.
Conflict: Short-term gain vs. long-term immigration status.
Story value: Security
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Clinical, sobering
Outcome: Ishita still says “maybe,” pocketing the risk.

Chapter 10:
Scene 1:
Characters: Carlos, students, Ines, Ishita
Place: Meyer Green
Time: Dinnertime
Event: Carlos leads a dining walkout; donated burritos arrive.
Conflict: Food insecurity vs. administration policy.
Story value: Solidarity
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Lively, defiant
Outcome: Lines form; students feed students.

Scene 2:
Characters: Ines, Ishita, Carlos, undergrads
Place: Same, under string lights and headlamps
Time: Late night
Event: Ines and Ishita hand out foil trays side by side until midnight.
Conflict: Exhaustion vs. commitment.
Story value: Community bond
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Warm, spent
Outcome: They clean up together; quiet rapport deepens.

Chapter 11:
Scene 1:
Characters: Ines, financial-aid rep (voicemail), Domingos
Place: Bike shop office
Time: Early morning
Event: Refund “review” freezes Ines’s funds; she crashes on a cot in Domingos’s back office.
Conflict: Bureaucracy vs. survival logistics.
Story value: Stability
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Stark, practical
Outcome: She showers at Arrillaga and heads to a double shift.

Scene 2:
Characters: Ines, Mateo
Place: Back table at a taqueria
Time: Evening
Event: Ines takes Mateo’s under‑the‑table coding gig.
Conflict: Risk of exploitation vs. cash need.
Story value: Autonomy
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Cautious, transactional
Outcome: She accepts; payment in cash, repo access via personal email.

Chapter 12:
Scene 1:
Characters: Ines, Mateo (remote), Slack ghosts
Place: Co-working nook, late
Time: Night
Event: Ines spots A/B tests running on residents’ mental‑health telemetry.
Conflict: Delivering for pay vs. complicity in harm.
Story value: Integrity
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Cold realization
Outcome: She exports proof, zips logs.

Scene 2:
Characters: Ines, Zadie, Naomi
Place: Outside Gates, breezy quad
Time: Next morning
Event: Ines returns the cash and walks out; Zadie forwards receipts to Naomi.
Conflict: Fear of backlash vs. whistle action.
Story value: Moral courage
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Clean, resolute
Outcome: Paper trail lands with Naomi; Ines burns the bridge.

Chapter 13:
Scene 1:
Characters: Naomi, Farzaneh, Dean Klein, task force members, press officer
Place: Dean’s conference room
Time: Morning
Event: Naomi publishes; Dean Klein convenes a containment task force; Farzaneh calls it “miscommunication.”
Conflict: Public record vs. institutional spin.
Story value: Legitimacy
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Controlled panic
Outcome: Task force narrows scope; damage-control memo drafted.

Scene 2:
Characters: Zadie, Ishita, Vaden clinician
Place: Vaden clinic waiting area and restroom
Time: Late afternoon
Event: Zadie breaks down and checks into Vaden; Ishita’s nosebleed stains her mask.
Conflict: Overload vs. care-seeking.
Story value: Health
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Spent, brittle
Outcome: Zadie gets intake; Ishita wipes blood, shakes, and stays in the hall.

chapters: The paper is accepted and Asha drills Ishita through a precise, documented refusal to the “methods tweak.”
Farzaneh pings at 1 a.m. demanding Ishita’s sign‑off and hinting her letters will vanish.
Naomi leaks emails proving the integrity dashboard repackaged Ines’s prototype with her timestamps intact.
Dean Klein offers a backroom credit while legal warns Ines speaking up could jeopardize her aid and jobs.
Omar files the formal complaint with Slack timestamps, and Ishita attaches her written refusal.
At Coupa, Ines calls it fraud and Ishita calls it survival, and they walk out in opposite directions under Hoover’s shadow.
Ines goes on‑record with Naomi and declines Klein’s committee seat.
Arjun ghosts after dangling day‑1 CPT, and Priyanka and Sanjay press Ishita to keep quiet for the visa.
Zadie returns from Vaden rested and sets boundary hours, while Carlos organizes free meals during a union action.
Layoffs wipe “safe” internships and OPT scrutiny snarls classmates at customs as Yifan warns Ishita to avoid Arjun’s trail.
Commencement under smoke; Ishita starts a vetted STEM OPT job and Ines leaves the Valley, then they meet at Terman Fountain and compare calendars like a truce.

Chapter 14:
Scene 1:
Characters: Ishita, Asha
Place: Gates office, whiteboard and Zoom open
Time: Morning after acceptance email
Event: Asha rehearses Ishita through a scripted refusal to “methods tweak,” with citations and version control receipts.
Conflict: Ishita fears burning bridges vs Asha insisting on a clean record.
Story value: Integrity vs expedience
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: clinical, braced
Outcome: Ishita finalizes a dated refusal doc and sends it.

Scene 2:
Characters: Ishita, Ines (text), Farzaneh (cc’d email, offstage)
Place: Huang courtyard bench
Time: Later that afternoon
Event: Ishita forwards her refusal to the author group; Ines replies “proud” but warns of fallout.
Conflict: Solidarity vs self-preservation
Story value: Trust
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: cautious
Outcome: Paper stands; tweak officially declined on record.

Chapter 15:
Scene 1:
Characters: Farzaneh, Ishita
Place: EVGR studio, laptop glow
Time: 1 a.m.
Event: Farzaneh pings demanding Ishita’s immediate sign‑off; hints letters could “get delayed.”
Conflict: Coercion vs boundary
Story value: Power
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: predatory, sleepless
Outcome: Ishita refuses to sign; promises only documented compliance.

Scene 2:
Characters: Ishita, Asha (call)
Place: EVGR courtyard walkway
Time: 1:30 a.m., cold
Event: Ishita calls Asha, recounts threat; Asha advises saving screenshots and routing through department admin.
Conflict: Panic vs process
Story value: Agency
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: steadied
Outcome: Ishita files a timestamped note to admin, archives Slack logs.

Chapter 16:

Characters: Naomi, Ines
Place: Green Library reading room
Time: Late morning
Event: Naomi shows email headers proving the dashboard reuses Ines’s prototype; timestamps intact.
Conflict: Proof vs institutional denial
Story value: Truth
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: vindicating, brittle
Outcome: Ines agrees to let Naomi quote the evidence off-record for now.

Scene 2:
Characters: Ines, Ishita
Place: Coupa café patio
Time: Early afternoon
Event: Ines tells Ishita about the leak; weighs risk of going public.
Conflict: Exposure vs safety
Story value: Safety
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: anxious
Outcome: They set a 48‑hour window to decide on‑record statements.

Chapter 17:
Scene 1:
Characters: Dean Klein, Ines
Place: Dean’s conference room
Time: Next morning
Event: Klein offers “quiet credit” on the dashboard; suggests future committee seat.
Conflict: Recognition vs silence
Story value: Legitimacy
Story value charge: Negative
